title: A tier made while a grid is in edit appears after Save as previous tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Open Settings › Pricing in a second browser tab.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Click New Tier in the second tab.
  5. Type a name no other tier uses in the second tab.
  6. Click Create Tier in the second tab.
  7. Type a new value in Default's first range in the first tab.
  8. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The second tab shows the New Tier page.

Step 5:

  • The name shows.

Step 6:

  • The new tier is created in the second tab.

Step 7:

  • The first tab's bar counts 1 change; the grid has no column for the new tier yet.

Step 8:

  • After the save the grid shows a column for the new tier, last, reading Uses previous tier.
